summary: Reconstructed the figure as a compiled TikZ standalone document (version 1, best_version=1). It draws a hexagon with vertices E, D, C, B, A, F and two interior segments, F–C and E–A, meeting at K. Vertex coordinates come from the bind_point_labels CV output (7 points, all labelled, no unmatched labels or points). The critic scored it 0.9 with checklist_score 1.0, must_repair=false, and all seven labels present. Its only issue is a low-severity note that the K label offset is slightly tight, which I left unchanged as informational.
